notes: ἀνήχθη heads on 'sail' following rule 104's set-plus-complement frame, which heads its complement without exception; heading on 'set' remains defensible if the verb word is read as the lexeme's gloss.
θέλοντος takes the supplied 'if' as a rule 86 participial helper, a participle being a token that carries subordination, so nothing here is added.
ἀποταξάμενος heads on 'leave' with the supplied possessive and object as rule 7 helpers, as 18:18 reads the same lexeme.
Two articles before names (s009, s014) are unrepresented under rule 23.
